 AS Roma will face Cagliari in the Italian Serie A on Tuesday.
 Cagliari will travel this week to take on AS Roma at the Olimpico in Rome, Italy, on Tuesday afternoon, airing in Canada. AS Roma has had a busy October with five games already and two games to go. They drew league matches with Como and Napoli, while beating Genoa. In between those league matches, AS Roma lost to Real Madrid from Spanish La Liga in the league phase of the UEFA Champions League. They then won in the league phase of the Champions League against Slovan Bratislava, 4-0. Donyell Malen leads the team in scoring this season with six goals in seven games. He is followed by Matìas Soulé, who has three goals in eight appearances.

 Cagliari has four wins this season, but none of them have come in October. With three games under its belt and only this game remaining, Cagliari is 0-1-2 in those matches. They drew the first game with Juventus, 1-1, before getting shut out against Monza on the road and against Bologna at home, giving up a combined six goals. Daniel Maldini is the only player on Cagliari’s team with more than one goal on the stat sheet. He has four goals in eight games. Alessandro Romano and Paul Mendy have one goal each.
 Eight games into the Serie A season, Inter Milan leads the league with 22 points, tied with SS Lazio at No. 2. AS Roma is 5-3-0 this season with a goal differential of +13, tied with the best goal differential in the league. It is four points behind Lazio and one ahead of Como. Cagliari is No. 8 in the standings with 12 points, tied with Torino, with a goal differential of -3. It is one point behind Frosinone and two points ahead of Juventus and Napoli. Cagliari is five points behind its opponent.
